description: Additive non-negative SIMT strided-load model fitted on the v4 1288-case page-aligned dataset.  Coefficients are ns/iteration; each term is a white-box line/duplication/page fact.

target.target_ns_definition: median of cleaned allocation samples for target_ns
target.target_p25_definition: lower-quartile of cleaned allocation samples for target_p25_ns

selection.criterion: pooled CV mean(LOBO MAPE, LOWO MAPE), then CV max, then in-sample max; the documented v4 final model is forced to the simpler no-WL + dup cap128 + lowW4 candidate

feature_notes.min_L_32: min(L,32); first 32 128B lines of fill/queue work
feature_notes.max_L_minus_32: max(0,L-32); additional lines past 32, cheaper due to overlap
feature_notes.dupL_minL_128: dup * L * min(L,128); replicated line requests capped at 128 lines (16KB)
feature_notes.cross_minL_32: cross * min(L,32); page-cross penalty on at most 32 lines (one 4KB page of 128B lines)
feature_notes.lowW_4_L: max(0,4-W)*L; fewer than four warps cannot hide line fill latency

profile_mapping.note: The coefficients are raw ns and map to the existing nanoseconds_to_system_cycles conversion.  Do not change the production profile until route-level validation passes.

formula_terms.quantity: min(L,32); first 32 128B lines of fill/queue work
max(0,L-32); additional lines past 32, cheaper due to overlap
dup * L * min(L,128); replicated line requests capped at 128 lines (16KB)
cross * min(L,32); page-cross penalty on at most 32 lines (one 4KB page of 128B lines)
max(0,4-W)*L; fewer than four warps cannot hide line fill latency
